subject: words
title: Count the parts
about: He sees a printed word and taps how many syllables it has, using the rule that every syllable has a vowel sound (NC RF.1.4.d). The Sounds subject claps spoken words; this level is the printed-word version, which is what the standard asks for.
tip: Have him put a finger under each vowel sound he can see, then count the fingers.
